verses.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.pt: Partiu, pois, Israel com tudo quanto tinha e veio a Beer-Seba, onde ofereceu sacrifícios ao Deus de seu pai Isaque.
verses.en_web: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
verses.en_bbe: And Israel went on his journey with all he had, and came to Beer-sheba, where he made offerings to the God of his father Isaac.

verses.en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
verses.pt: Falou Deus a Israel em visões de noite, e disse: Jacó, Jacó! Respondeu Jacó: Eis-me aqui.
verses.en_web: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.en_bbe: And God said to Israel in a night-vision, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

verses.en: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
verses.pt: E Deus disse: Eu sou Deus, o Deus de teu pai; não temas descer para o Egito; porque eu te farei ali uma grande nação.
verses.en_web: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, I am God, the God of your father: go down to Egypt without fear, for I will make a great nation of you there:

verses.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
verses.pt: Eu descerei contigo para o Egito, e certamente te farei tornar a subir; e José porá a sua mão sobre os teus olhos.
verses.en_web: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph will close your eyes.”
verses.en_bbe: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will see that you come back again, and at your death Joseph will put his hands on your eyes.

verses.en: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.pt: Então Jacó se levantou de Beer-Seba; e os filhos de Israel levaram seu pai Jacó, e seus meninos, e as suas mulheres, nos carros que Faraó enviara para o levar.
verses.en_web: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob went on from Beer-sheba; and the sons of Jacob took their father and their little ones and their wives in the carts which Pharaoh had sent for them.

verses.en: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
verses.pt: Também tomaram o seu gado e os seus bens que tinham adquirido na terra de Canaã, e vieram para o Egito, Jacó e toda a sua descendência com ele.
verses.en_web: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,
verses.en_bbe: And they took their cattle and all the goods which they had got in the land of Canaan, and came to Egypt, even Jacob and all his seed:

verses.en: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
verses.pt: Os seus filhos e os filhos de seus filhos com ele, as suas filhas e as filhas de seus filhos, e toda a sua descendência, levou-os consigo para o Egito.
verses.en_web: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: His sons and his sons' sons, his daughters and his daughters' sons and all his family he took with him into Egypt.

verses.en: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
verses.pt: São estes os nomes dos filhos de Israel, que vieram para o Egito, Jacó e seus filhos: Rúben, o primogênito de Jacó.
verses.en_web: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the names of the children of Israel who came into Egypt, even Jacob and all his sons: Reuben, Jacob's oldest son;

verses.en: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Rúben: Hanoque, Palu, Hezrom e Carmi.
verses.en_web: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch and Pallu and Hezron and Carmi;

verses.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Simeão: Jemuel, Jamim, Oade, Jaquim, Zoar, e Saul, filho de uma mulher cananéia.
verses.en_web: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and Jachin and Zohar and Shaul, the son of a woman of Canaan;

verses.en: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Levi: Gérsom, Coate e Merári.
verses.en_web: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari;

verses.en: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Judá: Er, Onã, Selá, Pérez e Zerá. Er e Onã, porém, morreram na terra de Canaã. E os filhos de Pérez foram Hezrom e Hamul,
verses.en_web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah and Perez and Zerah: but Er and Onan had come to their death in the land of Canaan; and the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.en: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Issacar: Tola, Puva, Iobe e Sinrom.
verses.en_web: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Issachar: Tola and Puah and Job and Shimron;

verses.en: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Zebulom: Serede, Elom e Jaleel.
verses.en_web: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered and Elon and Jahleel;

verses.en: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Léia, que ela deu a Jacó em Padã-Arã, além de Diná, sua filha; todas as almas de seus filhos e de suas filhas eram trinta e três.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.
verses.en_bbe: All these, together with his daughter Dinah, were the children of Leah, whom Jacob had by her in Paddan-aram; they were thirty-three in number.

verses.en: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Gade: Zifiom, Hagui, Suni, Ezbom, Eri, Arodi e Areli.
verses.en_web: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion and Haggi, Shuni and Ezbon, Eri and Arodi and Areli;

verses.en: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Aser: Imná, Isvá, Isvi e Beria, e Sera, a irmã deles; e os filhos de Beria: Heber e Malquiel.
verses.en_web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Asher: Jimnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah, and Sarah, their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

verses.en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Zilpa, a qual Labão deu à sua filha Léia; e estes ela deu a Jacó, ao todo dezesseis almas.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.
verses.en_bbe: These are the children of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah, and Jacob had these sixteen children by her.

verses.en: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Raquel, mulher de Jacó: José e Benjamim.
verses.en_web: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Jacob's wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.pt: E nasceram a José na terra do Egito Manassés e Efraim, que lhe deu Asenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om.
verses.en_web: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph had Manasseh and Ephraim in the land of Egypt, by Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On.

verses.en: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Benjamim: Belá, Bequer, Asbel, Gêra, Naamã, Eí, Ros, Mupim, Hupim e Arde.
verses.en_web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah and Becher and Ashbel, Gera and Naaman, Ehi and Rosh, Muppim and Huppim and Ard.

verses.en: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Raquel, que nasceram a Jacó, ao todo catorze almas.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
verses.en_bbe: All these were the children of Rachel whom Jacob had by her, fourteen persons.

verses.en: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Dã: Husim.
verses.en_web: The son of Dan: Hushim.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Dan was Hushim.

verses.en: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Naftali: Jazeel, Guni, Jezer e Silém.
verses.en_web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel and Guni and Jezer and Shillem.

verses.en: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Bila, a qual Labão deu à sua filha Raquel; e estes deu ela a Jacó, ao todo sete almas.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.
verses.en_bbe: These were the children of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel, seven persons.

verses.en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
verses.pt: Todas as almas que vieram com Jacó para o Egito e que saíram da sua coxa, fora as mulheres dos filhos de Jacó, eram todas sessenta e seis almas;
verses.en_web: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.
verses.en_bbe: All the persons who came with Jacob into Egypt, the offspring of his body, were sixty-six, without taking into account the wives of Jacob's sons.

verses.en: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
verses.pt: e os filhos de José, que lhe nasceram no Egito, eram duas almas. Todas as almas da casa de Jacó, que vieram para o Egito eram setenta.
verses.en_web: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Joseph whom he had in Egypt were two. Seventy persons of the family of Jacob came into Egypt.

verses.en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.pt: Ora, Jacó enviou Judá adiante de si a José, para o encaminhar a Gósen; e chegaram à terra de Gósen.
verses.en_web: He sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.en_bbe: Now he had sent Judah before him to Goshen, to get word from Joseph; and so they came to the land of Goshen.

verses.en: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.pt: Então José aprontou o seu carro, e subiu ao encontro de Israel, seu pai, a Gósen; e tendo-se-lhe apresentado, lançou-se ao seu pescoço, e chorou sobre o seu pescoço longo tempo.
verses.en_web: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph got his carriage ready and went to Goshen for the meeting with his father; and when he came before him, he put his arms round his neck, weeping.

verses.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
verses.pt: E Israel disse a José: Morra eu agora, já que tenho visto o teu rosto, pois que ainda vives.
verses.en_web: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
verses.en_bbe: And Israel said to Joseph, Now that I have seen you living again, I am ready for death.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.pt: Depois disse José a seus irmãos, e à casa de seu pai: Eu subirei e informarei a Faraó, e lhe direi: Meus irmãos e a casa de meu pai, que estavam na terra de Canaã, vieram para mim.
verses.en_web: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's people, I will go and give the news to Pharaoh, and say to him, My brothers and my father's people, from the land of Canaan, have come to me;

verses.en: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
verses.pt: Os homens são pastores, que se ocupam em apascentar gado; e trouxeram os seus rebanhos, o seu gado e tudo o que têm.
verses.en_web: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’
verses.en_bbe: And these men are keepers of sheep and owners of cattle, and have with them their flocks and their herds and all they have.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
verses.pt: Quando, pois, Faraó vos chamar e vos perguntar: Que ocupação é a vossa?
verses.en_web: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’
verses.en_bbe: Now when Pharaoh sends for you and says, What is your business?

verses.en: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.pt: respondereis: Nós, teus servos, temos sido pastores de gado desde a nossa mocidade até agora, tanto nós como nossos pais. Isso direis para que habiteis na terra de Gósen; porque todo pastor de ovelhas é abominação para os egípcios.
verses.en_web: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
verses.en_bbe: You are to say, Your servants have been keepers of cattle from our early days up to now, like our fathers; in this way you will be able to have the land of Goshen for yourselves; because keepers of sheep are unclean in the eyes of the Egyptians.
